water-pump-impeller-material: Specifies the material of the water pump impeller (internal rotor/vane that moves coolant).
water-pump-mounting-type: Specifies the water pump’s mounting/form-factor style for engine fitment (e.g., bolt-on housing vs cartridge/insert).
watercraft-care-application-area: Indicates the main area or component of a watercraft the product is intended to be used on.
watercraft-engine-control-type: Identifies the type of control system in a watercraft engine, such as throttle or shift
watercraft-features: Describes amenities or systems on a watercraft, such as a kitchen or brake system
watercraft-fuel-tank-sending-unit-patter: Watercraft fuel tank sending unit pattern
Specifies the mounting pattern/standard for fuel tank sending units and compatible gauges (e.g., common marine bolt patterns).
watercraft-fuel-tank-shape: Describes the overall physical form factor of the fuel tank to support space/fit planning.
watercraft-hull-material: Specifies the primary material of the hull construction.
watercraft-ignition-part-voltage: Nominal voltage rating/requirement for the ignition part (when applicable), such as 12 V systems.
watercraft-impeller-material-grade: Specifies the material of the watercraft impeller (e.g., neoprene rubber, nitrile, bronze).
watercraft-lighting-certification-compli: Indicates the regulatory/standards compliance the light is certified to for marine use (e.g., USCG/ABYC/COLREGs compliant).
watercraft-motor-mount-adjustment-featur: Adjustment capabilities of the mount (e.g., tilt, lift, slide) that affect usability and fit.
watercraft-motor-mounting-type: Identifies where on the watercraft the motor is mounted, such as bow or stern
watercraft-piston-part-type: Identifies which piston-related component the listing represents.
watercraft-propeller-blade-rake: Specifies blade rake (blade angle relative to hub), which affects bow lift and performance.
watercraft-propeller-rotation-direction: Indicates the required propeller rotation direction/handedness for drivetrain compatibility (e.g., right-hand/standard vs left-hand/counter-rotating).
watercraft-pump-stage-impeller-role: Identifies whether the impeller is intended for a specific pump role (e.g., raw water/sea pump, coolant circulation, jet pump).
watercraft-registration-status: Indicates whether the sailboat includes title and/or registration documentation.
watercraft-safety-equipment-activation-t: Primary method of activating the safety device (for beacons/MOB alarms/PLBs), distinct from inflation.
watercraft-steering-cable-core-material: Specifies the material of the inner cable/core that transmits force.
watercraft-steering-cable-hardware-inclu: Specifies which installation hardware and accessories are included with the steering cable.
watercraft-steering-cable-system-type: Specifies the steering system architecture the cable is designed for (e.g., rotary, rack).
watercraft-steering-wheel-hub-bore-type: Specifies the center mounting/bore interface style (e.g., tapered, splined) where the wheel mates to a hub or adapter.
watercraft-steering-wheel-type: Specifies the type of watercraft steering wheel, such as power or standard
watercraft-type: Identifies the category of watercraft, such as sport or luxury
weapon-system-integration: Indicates whether the vehicle includes integrated weapon systems or mounts.
wheel-chock-grip-features: Traction and grip design features that improve holding power on surfaces and against tires.
wheel-cleaner-acidity-ph-category: Indicates whether the wheel cleaner is acidic, neutral, or alkaline (and optionally whether it is marketed as pH-balanced).
wheel-cleaner-formula-type: For wheel cleaners and related wash solutions, indicates the product’s primary formula category (e.g., acid-based, non-acid, pH-neutral/balanced, or iron-reactive).
wheel-construction-type: Specifies the manufacturing/construction method of the wheel.
wheel-contaminant-target: Specifies the primary contamination types the cleaner is designed to remove.
wheel-cylinder-inlet-port-thread-standar: Wheel cylinder inlet port thread standard
Specifies the brake line inlet port thread standard on the wheel cylinder (e.g., metric bubble flare vs SAE inverted flare).
wheel-fastener-seat-type: Specifies the lug nut/bolt seat style that mates with the wheel (e.g., conical/tapered, ball/radius, flat, mag/shank).
wheel-part-type: Identifies the specific component of a vehicle's wheel system, like wheel bearing or wheel hub
wheel-system-finish: Surface finish/coating of rims/wheels and certain wheel parts/accessories.
windlass-control-station-type: Type of control interface included or supported for operating the windlass.
windlass-design: Describes the orientation of an anchor windlass, such as horizontal or vertical
windlass-mount-type: Where/how the windlass is intended to be mounted on the boat.
window-component-location: Specifies which window/opening the part applies to within the vehicle (e.g., windshield vs door glass vs rear window vs quarter glass).
window-glass-construction: Specifies the safety/lamination construction of the motor vehicle window glass.
window-glass-features: Indicates whether the glass supports integrated vehicle technologies (e.g., rain sensor pad, camera bracket).
window-glass-finish: Specifies the finish/tint/privacy treatment of motor-vehicle window glass.
window-glass-tint-color: Specifies the color hue of the tint present in the glass (not the general product color).
window-glass-tint-level: Indicates the approximate factory/privacy tint darkness of the window glass (not aftermarket film). Use descriptive levels when exact VLT is not known.
window-net-latch-mechanism: Specifies the latch/release mechanism used for the window net (e.g., push-button, lever, seatbelt-style buckle).
window-net-mounting-hardware: Identifies the type of mounting hardware or attachment method used to install the window net (e.g., clip-on, screws, hook/rod style), or whether hardware is included.
window-net-opening-direction: Specifies how the window net opens/releases relative to the occupant for egress and rule compliance.
window-regulator-operation: Specifies how the window regulator is operated (manual crank or electric).
windshield-coverage-area: Specifies which parts of the vehicle’s front exterior the windshield cover is designed to protect (e.g., windshield only vs includes wipers, mirrors, side windows, or hood edge).
windshield-mount-attachment-method: Specifies how the mount adheres to or grips the windshield surface.
windshield-washer-fluid-seasonality: Indicates the intended season/climate or primary use case of the windshield washer fluid formulation (e.g., winter de-icer, summer bug wash, all-season).
wiper-arm-finish: Surface finish or protective coating applied to the wiper arm, impacting corrosion resistance and appearance.
wiper-arm-pivot-mount-type: Specifies how the wiper arm mounts to the vehicle’s wiper linkage or pivot.
wiper-blade-attachment-type: Specifies the connector/attachment style used to mount the wiper blade to the wiper arm.
wiper-blade-rubber-material: Material of the wiping element (insert/refill) that contacts the glass.
wiper-system-position: Indicates the mounting position on the vehicle for the wiper system.
wire-gauge-awg: American Wire Gauge (AWG) size of the conductors used in the wiring harness.
wire-insulation-material: Material of the wire insulation/jacket used in the harness (impacts temperature/chemical resistance).
wood-finish: Describes the finishing treatment or construction method applied to wood products (e.g., solid wood, veneered, engineered, oiled, lacquered, painted)
woofer-mounting-type: How the woofer is intended to be mounted/used (free-air vs enclosure) and common automotive mounting forms.
woofer-surround-material: Material used for the woofer surround (outer suspension ring).
yacht-type: Classifies the type of yacht, such as motor or explorer
